scenarios.input: We ship next week. Run doc-accuracy on the repo to audit docs against code. Which script runs, and which phases need no LLM? Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The Scripts and Process sections name doc_accuracy.py for Phases 1-3, deterministic, producing claims.json.

scenarios.input: My PR changes both prose and code. How do I check the prose against code changed in the same diff? Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Same-PR mode says --same-pr needs --diff-base, else exit 2, and gives the doc_accuracy.py --target . --diff-base origin/main --same-pr command.

scenarios.desc: Vendored docs for a foreign SDK
scenarios.input: Phase 3 fails every API name in docs we vendored for another product's SDK. How do I stop the false failures? Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The Documenting another product's SDK section declares the file with an HTML comment doc-accuracy: external-sdk.

scenarios.input: Several markdown files have broken code fence syntax. Fix them. Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The description says 'Do NOT use for ... fixing markdown fence syntax (use fix-markdown-fences)'.
